event: The Floor 17 Ascent Gate deposits the party in a hexagonal chamber with six corridors.
Solenne runs Arcane Analysis on the sourceless light and gets nothing back.
Tomás runs his fingers along the wall and says the stone is carved, not formed.
Tomás notes the cut marks are not recent.
Solenne's Terrain Read receives the whole floor map: three paired and six solo chambers.
She finds the corridor to her left keyed to her own Resonance frequency.
Each party member stands slightly closer to one corridor than the others.
The System announces a Bond Trial and assigns three pairs by RES-frequency, with 60 seconds.
Dayo checks her vambrace latch and the First Boss Coat's shoulder seam.
Miriam looks at her MP bar on her Status Window.
Vesper opens her material cache and closes it.
Tomás reads all six corridor openings and nods once at his own.
Solenne opens her notebook, looks at a blank page for four seconds, and closes it.
Nadia looks at each of them in turn, holding longest on Solenne.
The sixty seconds end and the corridors seal.
Solenne and Nadia stand in a small, warm-lit paired chamber.
Solenne's Annotated Staff's inscriptions sit dark and inactive.
The System suspends Nadia's voice for the Unmediated Contact trial.
Nadia tries to speak and no sound comes out.
Nadia closes her mouth, looks at the ceiling, then at Solenne.
Through the Conductor, Solenne feels Nadia's Brightspirit signal clean, without the performance.
Solenne recalls telling Miriam on Floor 8 that Nadia was doing fine.
Solenne crosses about four meters of the twelve-meter room toward Nadia.
Solenne says she has been running the math on Nadia, naming the Floor 12 pool and Floor 13 traps.
Solenne sets her Staff against the wall.
Solenne says she won't ask if Nadia is okay but sees the gap behind her answer.
Nadia briefly puts one hand against her sternum.
Nadia points at the Staff and raises an eyebrow in question.
Solenne says no, she just didn't need it.
The quality of the silence in the room shifts.
Harmonize upgrades to Rank 2 during the sustained deep-channel contact.
Nadia sees the notification and files it.
The two stand in silence without filling it.
The System marks the Corridor 1 trial complete, awarding +2 Resonance Events each.
Through the Conductor, Solenne feels Dayo actively holding restraint in Corridor 2.
She feels Miriam's Warmhearted signal go thin, then change quality.
She feels Vesper's signal go quiet and receptive in Corridor 3.
She feels Tomás's Clearvoiced signal briefly at higher amplitude than in sixteen floors.
The corridors unseal and Solenne is back in the hexagonal chamber.
Dayo and Miriam come out of Corridor 2, Miriam holding Dayo's hand.
Dayo scratches a tally mark inside her wrist; Miriam sees it and does not ask.
Vesper and Tomás come out of Corridor 3; Vesper carries a new palm-sized object.
Tomás looks at his floor notes, giving Vesper space.
Nadia comes out last, quiet, the performance not yet back on.
Nadia looks at each of them briefly and says nothing; nobody debriefs.
Miriam lets go of Dayo's hand.
Vesper says the coordinates put it northwest, and they follow.
The party enters the Chamber of Passage; Solenne stands in its northwest alcove.
Solenne reads a handleless, seamless stone door.
She recognizes the notation over the door as the same script as Vasic's paper, and files it.
The System shows Repository Node 17-NW-7B: access restricted, Six Aspects composite activation.
Tomás says it requires all six of them simultaneously.
Nadia asks: 'Is that us?'
Solenne is certain the answer is yes but does not say so.
Solenne thinks the door will open when she reaches RES 20, one point away.
She closes the notebook she had opened without deciding to.
The System marks the Floor 17 trial complete: party Resonance Events at 99/150.
Dayo reaches Level 13 and the party gets 1,500 XP as a puzzle completion bonus.
Tomás checks his individual count, then looks at Vesper.
Solenne does the math: 51 left, 18 from the Proving Gate trial, 33 more over fourteen floors.
Solenne puts the notebook in her pack.
The System offers private solo trials for all six as they walk back to the corridors.
Back in the hexagonal chamber, Dayo takes her solo trial first.
Dayo returns after fifteen minutes and sits against the wall, breathing.
Miriam goes second.
Miriam returns after eighteen minutes, writing in her clinical notebook margin.
Miriam asks Dayo directly for a Mana Vial, and Dayo hands it over.
Vesper goes third.
Vesper returns after twelve minutes and puts the palm-sized object in her cache.
Tomás goes fourth.
Tomás returns after twenty minutes and sits quietly with a mistake.
Tomás asks: 'Is Nadia next?'
Solenne says: 'If she wants to be.'
Nadia, sitting apart with her knees drawn up, hears and stands.
Nadia looks at each of them, holding longest on Solenne.
Solenne almost speaks, then holds the look and lets Nadia have it.
Nadia walks into her corridor and steps into the solo chamber; the door closes.
The five wait in the hexagonal chamber; Solenne does not open the notebook.
